iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: Day 78. CRITICAL: Iran denies plan to transfer enriched uranium to US, contradicting deal claims. US considering releasing $20B in frozen assets in lieu of stockpile. IAEA DG Grossi demands 'very detailed' verification. Iran rules out enrichment restrictions completely. US demands 20-yr freeze, Iran offers 5 yrs. IAEA locked out 8+ months. Experts: stockpile could yield up to 10 bombs. NPT Review Conference Apr 27. Probability 32%. Rising.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Day 78. CRITICAL: Trump extended ceasefire but US naval blockade remains. British military reports another ship attacked in Hormuz. Container shipping still blocked. Iran says no delegation traveled to Pakistan yet for talks. FM: won't negotiate under threat. US issued new 'Economic Fury' sanctions, seized Iranian cargo ship. IRGC fired on commercial vessels. State media warns 'regret-inducing response.' Pakistan emerging as mediator via Army Chief. 40-nation coalition planning Hormuz mission. Oil volatile. Probability 42%. Stable.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel-Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Day 6 of 10-day ceasefire (expires Apr 26). Hezbollah fired rockets/drones Apr 21 accusing IDF of violations. First direct Israel-Lebanon talks underway in Washington. Israel ruled out Hezbollah disarmament as precondition. 2,196 killed in Lebanon. Probability 17%. Falling slightly due to direct talks.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: ELEVATED: Erdogan openly threatened military action against Israel on Apr 12, 2026. Nordic Monitor reports Turkey quietly preparing for war-like scenario with Israel as primary target. Hosting NATO Summit Ankara Jul 7-8. Pushing larger role in European defense. Probability 6%. Rising.

india.name: India-Pakistan
india.notes: ELEVATED: CFR report warns India-Pakistan armed conflict likely in 2026 driven by terrorism. Hormuz closure threatens India energy imports. India strongly condemned Hormuz conflict as unacceptable. No new direct military incidents. Probability 8%. Stable.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: Day 78. CRITICAL: Finland moving to lift long-standing ban on hosting nuclear weapons. Parliament voted to withdraw from Ottawa Convention. First F-35A nuclear-capable jets arriving 2026. Kremlin: 'will force countermeasures.' Russia reinforcing strategic/nuclear assets near Finnish border. Danish intel: Russia ready for localized war in 6 months. Probability 34%. Rising.

china.name: China
china.notes: CRITICAL: US and allies conducted large-scale exercises near Taiwan Apr 20 — Japanese troops participated on large scale for first time. China says military activities around Taiwan 'reasonable, justified.' Xi met Taiwan opposition leader Cheng Li-wun. China fully supports Pakistan mediation on Iran. Beijing calls Iran war at 'critical stage of transition.' Probability 40%. Rising.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: Day 76. RISING: Launched 5 tactical ballistic missiles from Sinpo Apr 19 — 7th test of 2026, 4th in April. Kim expressed 'great satisfaction' over Hwasong-11 variant accuracy. Also tested cruise/anti-ship missiles from destroyer Choe Hyon. Constitutional nuclear status irreversible. Probability 20%. Rising.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia-Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4, Day 1180+. Easter truce expired Apr 12 amid thousands of mutual violations. Russia refuses to extend unless Kyiv accepts terms. Ukraine crippling Russian oil infrastructure — 40% export capacity disabled. Pre-truce Russia launched 659 drones + 44 missiles, 16+ killed. Lavrov: patience 'not unlimited.' Probability 36%. Stable.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan-Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: STABLE: China-mediated Urumqi talks ongoing since Apr 1. Both agreed not to escalate but fighting continues at lower intensity. Pakistan mortars killed Afghan civilians during talks. No formal agreement yet. Pakistan Army Chief now also mediating US-Iran talks. Probability 5%. Stable.
